pr_title: GameEngine: implement ADR 0142 agent benchmark catalog
pr_body:
## Summary

- Implement ADR 0142 GameEngine Agent Benchmark and curated local model catalog on current main.
- Preserve existing Agent Host, native inference, provider, serialization, and project-authoring contracts.
- Add benchmark evidence/storage/catalog UI and model discovery without silently downloading model weights.
